question:
The letter T is formed by placing two \(2 \times 4\) inch rectangles next to each other, as shown. What is the perimeter of the T, in inches?

[Figure 1](figures/2006_AMC_8_Q06_question_fig1.svg)
solution:
Only the outside boundary contributes to the perimeter of the T. Each \(2\times4\) rectangle has perimeter
\[
2(2+4)=12\text{ inches}.
\]
The rectangles meet along the stem's \(2\)-inch top edge. Adding their perimeters counts this shared edge twice, but it lies inside the T and should not be counted. Removing both copies gives
\[
12+12-2\cdot2=\boxed{20}\text{ inches}.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
